title: Best Gear
notes: Every item in your bag now shows how much Power it adds (+ green) or loses (- red) compared with what you wear, enhance levels included.
Item details tell you: 'Better, equip it', 'Enhance to +N and it beats your current item', or 'Never better, salvage it'.
Equip best rechecked: it compares real Power (a strong +8 item stays on over a weaker fresh drop) and counts set bonuses correctly. It shows your Power before and after.
Skill keys always answer: if a skill can't fire you now see why ('Need 2 ◆', 'unlocks at Lv 3'). Numpad 1-3 work too.
